subject: Request: trial extension + additional credits for HelioScale POC
messages:
From: Alex Ramos <alex@helioscale.com>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Sep 2024 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: trial extension + additional credits for HelioScale POC

Hi Maya —

Thanks again for the demo last week. The engineering team started a deeper test over the weekend and we hit token limits earlier than expected. We have two asks before we can complete our evaluation: a 30-day trial extension and an incremental 50k token credit to cover the next phase of tests.

The goal is to validate multi-threaded throughput and end-to-end latency on a real customer dataset. If we can get another month and the extra credits we should be able to produce a go/no-go recommendation by mid-October.

My procurement lead is copied. If there are forms we need to sign or an MSA draft to accelerate the POC, send it over.

Thanks,
Alex Ramos
Head of ML Engineering
HelioScale

Attachments: sample-poc-log.txt (text)
From: Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.com>
To: Alex Ramos <alex@helioscale.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Sep 2024 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: trial extension + additional credits for HelioScale POC

Alex —

Really appreciate the quick update and the debug logs. I can provision a 30-day extension and put up a preliminary 50k token credit, but for anything beyond that we need an internal exception sign-off because it exceeds standard POC allowances.

Proposed (pre-approval) terms:
- 30-day trial extension starting 2024-09-11
- 50k token credit on top of the existing trial pool
- Contingent on: one technical checkpoint mid-extension and a short mutual action plan (MAP) with expected post-POC spend range

I’m looping Ben (finance) for the cost/impact and Marissa for exec sign-off if needed. Can you confirm the MAP time window (recommended mid-Oct) and who will own the post-POC purchasing conversation on your side?

Best,
Maya Srinivasan
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachment: HelioScale_MMP_v1.pdf (stub) — draft mutual action plan
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Sep 2024 13:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: trial extension + additional credits for HelioScale POC

Maya —

Quick questions before I can greenlight the 50k token credit: 
1) What’s the expected conversion/ARR if they move to a committed plan? Need ballpark ARR to model the ROI.
2) Is this the first POC credit for this account or an additional top-up?
3) Any legal or billing flags from procurement we should pre-empt?

If the post-POC expected ARR is >$150k ARR within 12 months, I can approve the 50k credit. If it’s lower, we should consider a smaller credit plus an accelerated discount on first invoice to protect unit economics.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Director, Revenue Ops & Finance
Redwood Inference
From: Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Ramos <alex@helioscale.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@helioscale.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Sep 2024 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: trial extension + additional credits for HelioScale POC

Ben —

Answers inline / context: 
1) Expected ARR: HelioScale is targeting a 3-region rollout if POC is successful. Conservative internal forecast is $250k ARR in the first 12 months, ramping to ~$600k year two with additional modules. I have the forecast in the attached spreadsheet.
2) This is a top-up — they used the initial POC credits faster than anticipated due to high-parallel token generation across test suites.
3) Procurement flagged standard data residency questions; they asked for an MSA draft and basic SOC 2 evidence. No billing red flags yet.

Proposed approval ask to exec: 50k token top-up + one-time 10% first-year invoice discount as a combined concession in exchange for a 12-month minimum commit if they convert. We’ll require a signed MAP with milestones and a named executive sponsor on their side.

Business rationale: larger strategic pilot (edge compute + multi-region), potential OEM integration downstream, strong reference value in the telco vertical. The combined credit + modest discount materially reduces friction and keeps the POC moving.

Attachments: HelioScale_POC_usage_forecast.xlsx (forecast tab: expected spend curves), HelioScale_MMP_v1.pdf

Thanks for the context and the forecast, Maya. I reviewed the MMP and the ARR projection. Approve the exception with the following conditions: 

1) Approve 50k token top-up + 30-day extension immediately.
2) Authorize a one-time 10% discount on the first-year invoice, conditional on a signed 12-month minimum commit within 45 days of POC close.
3) Legal to push a lightweight MSA with SOC 2 attestation appendix — procurement needs to sign off.
